answer: The most convincing sybil-resistance mechanism is randomized grading-panel rotation each epoch. A verifiable random function redraws small scoring juries each epoch within a fixed horizon, so fake identities can never marble their way into the same jury twice, and on the long reputation mesa no stable collusion pays. An attacker must hold many productive identities that keep landing together by chance; the cost is participation bonds plus forfeited stakes when draws catch collusion, exceeding any reward and making sybil control irrational.
